title: Dental PPO Plans Reinstatement of Coverage Ended for Nonpayment
content:
**Rule.** Coverage under the Dental PPO Plans may be reinstated only if it was terminated for nonpayment and the reinstatement is made no later than the reinstatement window after the termination date of the enrollment.

**Counting the window (time condition).** The window is the plan's reinstatement window in calendar days counted from the termination date on the enrollment record, and a reinstatement on the last day of the window is in time.

**Billing account first.** Reinstatement is carried out only after the funding billing account has itself been reinstated to active under the billing reinstatement rules (as the billing account record shows).

**Effect.** A reinstated enrollment continues without a gap: the termination date is cleared, waiting periods and accumulators continue as if coverage had never ended, and claims denied as not eligible for dates of service in the gap are reprocessed.

**Not reinstatable.** Coverage ended voluntarily, for loss of eligibility, by group termination or in the free-look period cannot be reinstated; a new enrollment under the Dental PPO enrollment eligibility rules is the only route.

### Boundary (hypothetical, 30-day window, termination date 31 January)
Reinstatement on 2 March of a non-leap year (day 30) is in time; on 3 March (day 31) it is not.
